candidate.title: Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults
candidate.text: Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults. This will make the cluster boot up correctly in IPv6 only environments, where IPv4 preference will break it due to lack of IPv4 addresses.

evidence.excerpt:
* Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults.
  This will make the cluster boot up correctly in IPv6 only environments, where IPv4 preference will break it due to lack of IPv4 addresses.
